_help: The main story's own clock, by act: dated events, and moves_on, which moves the story on to the next act if nobody has by then. It never moves on to the last act by itself, since the fleet has to be taken there.

after is how many days into the act, give or take a fifth. news is what people hear. fleet changes the fleet: morale, food, medicine, parts, fuel, pursuit, ships, picked and named, as in the stories' files.
Each story's own clock is in its file in world/stories, under If nobody steps in and Consequences.

events.news: Legate Corvane's offer is going round the mess decks, in copies somebody's been very careful to leave where people will find them.
A Mimic scare on the Harrow's Bounty has people looking at each other, and at the fleet's synthetics, and not saying anything.
The first sermons of the Quiet are drawing crowds on the Sundial, and they've started asking for more room.
A Choir drone picked off a straggler at the edge of the formation. Nobody saw it coming, and everybody saw it happen.

moves_on.news: Garrick Fenn has broken the story on the open channel: part of the Beacon is in Concord Navy code. Half the fleet's celebrating, and the other half has started asking why they weren't told.

events.news: Hunter packs are working the lanes that follow the Beacon's signal, and ships that went down them have stopped answering.
Hegemony customs stops and Inquisitors have started working the docks at Haven Station.
Refugees are signing at Bastion Nine by the hundred, and a ship from the fleet has gone with them.
There was a fight between synthetics and survivors on the Second Thursday, and it took marines to end it.

moves_on.news: It's been said on the open channel: the Navy voice on the Beacon is a ship the Choir took on the first night. A lot of people have stopped looking at the Beacon, and started looking at the bridge.

events.news: Ships are peeling off for Bastion Nine, now that people have started to doubt the Beacon.
Hunters have started turning up with something coordinating them, and they've stopped making mistakes.
Inquisitor Vael's ships are sitting over Ilun, and the monks have gone on sitting too.
People on the Bright Tomorrow have found a man who's stopped answering to his name. He's sitting in a corridor, perfectly healthy, and he doesn't look round.

moves_on.news: Word's coming in from three different places at once that the Beacon isn't calling anyone home. Nobody can say what it is, and nobody's sleeping.

events.news: People who've never heard the song have started humming it, all over the fleet, and they don't know they're doing it.
A ship in the fleet has stopped answering. Every soul aboard has sat down, alive, all facing the same way.
Silver has been seen gathering along the Hegemony's border, and the Regent's fleet is mustering at Vantor.
Ministry Blades have landed at Sarn, and the Keepers have sent out one polite protest, in triplicate.
